newsitem.title: HUNGARY: Borsodchem hits high, others mixed in Budapest mkt.
newsitem.headline: Borsodchem hits high, others mixed in Budapest mkt.

text.p: Hungarian share prices closed mixed on the Budapest Stock Exchange as many of the market's key papers traded in narrow ranges, traders said.
The BUX index ended at 3,606.82 points, down 7.38.
"There weren't any substantial price movements and the seven point change (in the spot BUX index) shows no significant trend either," said Peter Haas of Postabank Securities.
Traders said they saw a wait-and-see attitude by many investors who were looking forward to January-September results in the hope that they will give a boost to the market.
"I feel everybody is waiting for companies' reports," Haas said, adding that chemical company Borsodchem was among those most eagerly awaited.
"In the case of Borsodchem there are high expectations of good results," he said, adding that this was reflected in Monday's rise in the share.
Borsodchem shares jumped to a new high of 3,265 forints before retreating to close at 3,255 forints, up 50.
Monday's most actively traded paper, chemical firm TVK shares, fell to end at 1,330 forints, down 15.
"Investors apparently don't have much confidence in this share," Haas said. "Some very positive news would be needed to move its price out of its current levels."
Demand was strong for pharmaceuticals company Richter but this coincided with strong supply which Haas said was presumably due to profit-taking.
Clothing industrial Styl closed at 1,295 forints, down 100, after releasing its January-September figures which showed profits below last year's level but in line with the company's 1996 budget.
